scope: Retrospective arithmetic150 cached-answer headroom study on an already exposed development panel; no new model evaluation or qualification.

panel.id_hash_encoding: UTF-8 JSON sorted list, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon)
panel.termination: EOS required; recomputed from raw saved termination flag; not regenerated
panel.family_scores: One row per distinct family, retained in rows.csv with binary correctness. Class counts are descriptive; repeated policies/models are not independent observations.

provenance.weight_hash_scope: Historical metadata declarations cross-checked only; no weight file read or current file qualification.

supa_initial.capture: last20.checkpoints[0].outputs; exact equality required against fullb28.checkpoints[0].outputs

last20_fp32.storage: FP32 trainable checkpoint reconstructed with frozen source
last20_fp32.training: last 20 blocks; 5233 supervised tokens; 41 steps; seed 17

fullb28_fp32.training: full B28; matched draw/dose/schedule; 5233 tokens; 41 steps; seed 17

opallo_bf16_storage_fp32_compute.storage: published BF16 core derived from the same last20 seed 17 checkpoint
opallo_bf16_storage_fp32_compute.compute: BF16 weights upcast to CPU FP32; historical PANEL probe
opallo_bf16_storage_fp32_compute.training: same lineage as last20_fp32; not an independent training draw

resource_budget.lane: sequential CPU-only offline analysis, one process, Python standard library
resource_budget.monitoring: Current/peak process RSS and host physical/commit memory at stage boundaries on Windows; root supervisor supplies continuous admission, polling, timeout and limits. No GPU compute.

analysis_predeclaration: Independently rescore every saved raw answer using immutable source retention.py and audit overlay under strict and permissive policies; caller correctness never overrides parser.

Verify hashes, IDs, full messages and operative prompt bindings, 150 unique families, exact Supa initialization equality, lineage/precision metadata, matched draw/dose, and stored aggregate/per-row scoring cross-checks.
Report class and family scores, every pair both/left-only/right-only/neither correct, every nonempty subset oracle union, best single, headroom and joint failure IDs.
Report source retained/lost/gained separately; gains cannot offset losses. Preserve format/type rejection, parsed numeric/clock mismatch, EOS failure and bare-policy sensitivity.
Compare text and exact typed value differences separately; never extract a number from rejected free-form prose.

Every oracle union is retrospective headroom using known targets, not a selector evaluation, sampling gain, merged weights or a current native qualification. No p-values or new population efficacy claims.
